name: Dewey Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Dewey Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. Delaware doesn't allow golf carts on its highways. LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less, but not Coastal Highway outside towns, and not in Fenwick Island at all.

lsv.notes: Not Coastal Hwy outside towns; not in Fenwick Island

rules.rule: Golf carts are not allowed to operate on Delaware highways
LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; not on dual highways outside towns except to cross
Low-speed vehicles prohibited on town streets

faq.q: Where can I drive my LSV in Dewey Beach?
faq.a: Roads posted 35 mph or less. Not Coastal Hwy outside towns; not in Fenwick Island. A town or county can still ban LSVs from a specific road, and posted signs win.

faq.q: Can I drive a golf cart in Dewey Beach?
faq.a: No. Delaware DMV says golf carts aren't allowed on Delaware highways. Only registered LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

faq.q: Can I drive an LSV in Fenwick Island?
faq.a: No. Fenwick Island's town code prohibits low-speed vehicles.
